parts.name: Knob
parts.Basic_description: A small plastic knob located on the front of the coffee machine used for controlling power or brewing settings.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to adjust brewing parameters such as temperature or strength by rotating or pressing it.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or be pressed depending on the design, providing user input to the machine.

parts.name: Container
parts.Basic_description: A glass container that holds the brewed coffee, typically transparent and heat-resistant.
parts.Functional_description: It collects and stores the brewed coffee, allowing easy pouring through its handle and spout.
parts.Movement_description: It can be detached from the base for cleaning or serving, but remains stationary during brewing.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: A plastic lid that covers the top of the container to prevent spills and retain heat.
parts.Functional_description: It seals the container during brewing to maintain temperature and prevent splashing.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted or rotated for filling or cleaning, but remains fixed during operation.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main body of the coffee machine that houses the heating element, electronics, and control interface.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the container and contains the electrical components responsible for heating and brewing.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during operation and serves as the structural foundation of the machine.
